selection_policy.main_experiment: Use the first default_n subfields in the listed order for a fixed main-experiment slice.
selection_policy.extension_rule: Append new subfields only at the end of a subject list; do not reorder or rename frozen entries.
selection_policy.prompt_context: Use subfield name only for the main M1 versus M2 coverage experiment. Descriptions are for taxonomy review and documentation.
